newsitem.title: FRANCE: DHL France turnover rises in 1996.
newsitem.headline: DHL France turnover rises in 1996.

text.p: DHL France, the French arm of DHL Worldwide Express, said 1996 turnover grew to 945 million francs ($168 million) from 841 million francs the previous year.

"Turnover growth reflects a strong increase in the volume of traffic handled in 1996 which reached an average of 30,000 items (import and export traffic included) per day compared to around 25,000 in 1995," a DHL official told Reuters.
"Last year's results are in keeping with the development we have achieved in turnover and trafic volume annually over the past four to five years," he added.
DHL France's 1996 traffic was up by between 30 and 35 percent in terms of weight on 1995 levels which illustrated a growing presence at the heavier end of the express market.
DHL France will invest 25 million francs in opening nine branch offices in France during 1997, in addition to its existing network of 22 such offices, the official said.
